page_title: GRA 2-0 ALA | Granada CF v Alaves 14/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' The match has just finished.

90+3' Carlos Benavidez (Alaves) attempts to convert a lofted cross as he jumps high and heads the ball to the middle of the goal. Augusto Batalla shows his brilliant reflexes and pulls off a glorious save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
90' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.

88' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Giuliano Simeone (Alaves) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the roof of the net, but Augusto Batalla pulls off a brilliant save.
87' Flag up against Kike Garcia (Alaves). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
84' Jose Callejon (Granada CF) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
83' Jose Ramon Sandoval has decided to make a change. Martin Hongla (Granada CF) replaces Gerard Gumbau.
83' Matias Arezo (Granada CF) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Lucas Boye.
82' The corner is swung in but Alaves can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

81' Ruben Duarte (Alaves) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort. Corner kick. Alaves will have an opportunity.
80' Gonzalo Villar (Granada CF) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.

78' Andoni Gorosabel (Alaves) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety.
75' We are about to witness a subsitution. Jose Callejon (Granada CF) for Myrto Uzuni.
73' Carlos Benavidez (Alaves) brings his opponent down. Victor Garcia has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
71' Alaves can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
71' Luis Garcia Plaza decides to make a substitution. Joaquin Panichelli will be replaced by Giuliano Simeone (Alaves).
68' Abderrahmane Rebbach (Alaves) picks up a precise pass and attempts to threaten the keeper with a long-range effort, but it goes well wide of the mark.
66' Victor Garcia blows his whistle for a foul after Rafa Marin (Alaves) hacks down one of his opponents.
64' We are about to witness a substitution. Carlos Benavidez (Alaves) is replacing Antonio Blanco.
64' Here is a change. Samu Omorodion is going off and Luis Garcia Plaza gives the last tactical orders to Kike Garcia (Alaves).
64' Kamil Jozwiak will be replaced by Gonzalo Villar (Granada CF).

63' This was a piece of cake for Antonio Sivera. Myrto Uzuni (Granada CF) found himself some space after latching on to a pass, but his strike only went low to the middle of the goal and into the gloves of the prepared keeper.
63' Kamil Jozwiak (Granada CF) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
61' Alex Sola (Alaves) takes the corner which is cleared.

61' Andoni Gorosabel (Alaves) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Alaves.
60' Miguel Rubio (Granada CF) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Victor Garcia had an easy-decision to make.
58' Joaquin Panichelli (Alaves) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety.
56' Andoni Gorosabel (Alaves) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
54' A precise low pass is received by Joaquin Panichelli (Alaves), who makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box, but his poorly placed shot sails well over the bar.

50' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Joaquin Panichelli (Alaves) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the bottom left corner, but Augusto Batalla pulls off a brilliant save.
49' Victor Garcia blows his whistle after Kamil Jozwiak (Granada CF) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
46' Luis Garcia Plaza prepares a substitution. Carlos Vicente is replaced by Abderrahmane Rebbach (Alaves).
46' Half-time substitution. Luis Rioja (Alaves) will not participate anymore and Alex Sola is coming on.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+4' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+4' Lucas Boye (Granada CF) finds space inside the box but rifles his effort just wide of the right post.
45+3' A yellow card for a tackle by Gerard Gumbau (Granada CF). Victor Garcia doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
45+3' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Alaves.
45+2' Gerard Gumbau (Granada CF) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger. Granada CF have been awarded a corner kick.
45+1' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Nahuel Tenaglia (Alaves) sees a yellow card. He should be more careful because one more challenge like that could result in a red card.
45' Victor Garcia shows the yellow card to Myrto Uzuni (Granada CF) for a heavy challenge.
44' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) sends a cross into the box, but Augusto Batalla comes off his line to gather the ball.
41' One of the players from Alaves times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
38' 2 - 0 Lucas Boye (Granada CF) leaps to connect with a delightful cross and places his sweet header inside the right post. The goalkeeper had no chance to make a save.
36' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Alaves comes to nothing.
34' This shall not pass! Myrto Uzuni (Granada CF) lines up a shot from the edge of the box and goes for goal, but the effort is well blocked by a defender.
30' The free kick is delivered by Gerard Gumbau (Granada CF) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.

29' Ruben Duarte (Alaves) meets a pass on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards the middle of the goal. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Augusto Batalla pulls off an easy save.
27' Alaves work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
25' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Alaves, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
25' The referee blows his whistle as Ignasi Miquel (Granada CF) was too aggressive in his challenge.
20' The foul by Andoni Gorosabel (Alaves) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Victor Garcia.
14' Sergio Ruiz (Granada CF) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked.
13' Victor Garcia blows his whistle and it's Kamil Jozwiak (Granada CF) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
9' 1 - 0 Goal! Myrto Uzuni (Granada CF) puts the ball into the left side of the goal past the outstretched arm of Antonio Sivera.
9' Myrto Uzuni (Granada CF) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
8' Andoni Gorosabel (Alaves) clearly handles the ball, but he is surprised when the referee blows his whistle. Granada CF are awarded a penalty kick!
7' Facundo Pellistri (Granada CF) expertly controls a neat clever pass inside the box, but his effort crashes against the left post! What an opportunity that was!
3' Facundo Pellistri (Granada CF) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out at last! Granada CF will take the kick-off.
Victor Garcia is the one to supervise the game today.
